BEATBOX AUDIO SAMPLES

Place these five WAV files in this folder, using these exact lowercase names:

kick.wav
clap.wav
cymbal.wav
synth.wav
bass.wav

Then run npm run build:beatbox from the Sound/Sculpt project root.
The build copies the files to dist/beatbox/stems/ for local preview and deployment.

For a quick local preview without rebuilding, the five files can also be placed
in dist/beatbox/stems/. Put the source copies here too so a rebuild keeps them.

The files were not included in the supplied ZIP. No replacement sounds are added.
